item.title: AirLink 0.11.0
item.description:
AirLink 0.11.0 improves transfer-buffer efficiency and organizes setup and settings. This is a private development preview for manual installation.
## Setup and settings
- Setup has three steps: name, receive folder, then a review with notification choices and a direct next-device action. Existing setup, custom folders, pairings and transfer data remain saved. - Settings are grouped into General, Receiving, Transfers and About, plus Shortcuts on macOS. Save/Discard and validation stay visible. - Drafts survive category changes. Untouched values follow newer settings; saving applies only deliberate edits to the latest snapshot. Windows also preserves drafts through main navigation and appearance/language rebuilds. - A hidden Windows main window skips visual-tree work while transfers, controller state and tray notifications continue.
## Transfer work
- Exact-sized bounded chunk reads replace growing temporary buffers. Identical already-durable sender offset/hash updates avoid a redundant SQLite transaction. - TLS 1.3, block and full-file SHA-256, source identity checks, file/directory sync and durable checkpoint confirmation remain enabled. - Isolated 8-MiB source/receive operations allocate about 50.8% fewer bytes and took about 10% less time in three-run microbenchmarks. This is not a claim of a 50% reduction in overall app RAM. - Complete same-Mac TLS medians: 300 MiB 0.966 → 0.941 seconds; 128 small files 1.989 → 1.923 seconds. Those small timing differences are close to ordinary variation. The earlier physical WLAN/Windows minute was not reproduced or proven fixed.
## Verification
177 top-level Go race tests / 292 cases and go vet passed. 67 Swift tests include actual-helper transfer/removal/restart cases; 41 Windows Core tests passed against the final 0.11 service; all 68 web tests and the production web build passed. Universal macOS and both native Windows architecture builds passed. Every independent transfer fixture hash matches.
No app GUI or Windows installer was automated. Physical Windows UI, real WLAN throughput and 100-GB acceptance remain separate. macOS is ad hoc signed and not notarized; Windows Setup has no Authenticode signature. Ed25519 update/package signatures are a separate authenticity check.
## Install manually
Download the universal macOS DMG, Windows x64 Setup for Intel/AMD, or Windows ARM64 Setup below. Quit the existing app when replacing it or when Setup asks. Keep only the intended current AirLink app under /Applications; application data and received files remain separate.
The repository stays private. Sign in to GitHub with access to download a build; the existing unauthenticated in-app updater cannot access this private channel. Linux remains experimental source-only without a binary download. SHA256SUMS.txt covers the three native packages and UPDATE-SIGNATURES.json.
